attempted_claim: Let K be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, let S=K[x_1,x_2,x_3,x_4], and let F=X^u-X^v be a homogeneous binomial in the divided-power dual with u,v in N^4, |u|=|v|, u not equal to v, and Ann_S(F)_1=0. For A_F=S/Ann_S(F), determine a necessary-and-sufficient criterion in terms of u and v (after normalizing coefficients and permuting variables) for Tor^S_*(A_F,K) to have each of Kustin-Miller's codimension-four Gorenstein Tor-algebra classes A, B, C, or D, and give the corresponding normalized multiplication table, explicitly separating the already-characterized complete-intersection cases (class A) from the non-complete-intersection cases.
decisive_failure: No computer algebra system was available and the Kustin-Miller 1985 classification source is paywalled, so Tor-algebra product definitions were reconstructed from secondary documentation and package source. The exact rational K-resolution and Tor-product rank computations exceeded the bounded compute budget without output, leaving classes B, C, and D unverified. Partial artifacts cover only finitely many representatives and do not support any classification claim.
